name: Vexcalibur

frame.name: M1R Distribution Matrix
frame.description: Fires a spread. Equipped with a quick-draining shield. Blocking damage with your shield gradually bestows Void overshields to yourself and nearby allies.

perks.name: Ballistic Tuning
perks.description:
Power diverted from shield.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases shield duration

perks.name: Low-Impedance Windings
perks.description:
Improved output efficiency.
  •  Increases shield duration
  •  Slightly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases range

perks.name: Tempered Truss Rod
perks.description:
High stiffness for quick handling.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases reload speed
  •  Slightly decreases range

perks.name: Supercooled Accelerator
perks.description:
Optimized for extended range.
  •  Increases range
  •  Slightly decreases reload speed
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Auxiliary Reserves
perks.description:
Additional energy storage.
  •  Greatly increases shield duration
  •  Decreases reload speed

perks.name: Lightweight Emitter
perks.description:
Weight reduction for better agility.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Decreases shield duration

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.description:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.description: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.description:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.description:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Swap Mag
perks.description: Increases this weapon's ready and stow speed.

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.description:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Perpetual Loophole
perks.description: Deal additional melee damage while protected by an overshield. Defeating targets with melee final blows while the overshield is active will refresh it.

perks.name: Hand-Laid Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Fitted Stock
perks.description:
This stock makes the weapon stable but heavy
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Short-Action Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is especially easy to grip.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

perks.name: Immovable Refit
perks.description: Dealing ranged damage grants increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.

perks.name: Robber Refit
perks.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Feedback Refit
perks.description: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.

flavor: And they came to a lake fair and broad. "Lo," said the voice, "yonder is the blade that I spoke of."

catalyst.description: Dealing ranged damage grants increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.
